condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM potassium_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND potassium_value < 3.5 ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Recent potassium log is below range (K+ < 3.5 mEq/L). Review potassium intake targets with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM potassium_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND potassium_value > 5.5 ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Potassium log is above range (K+ > 5.5 mEq/L). Use clinician-set potassium targets before changing intake.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM fasting_blood_sugar_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND fbs_mg_dl > 125 ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Fasting blood sugar log is above threshold (FBS > 125 mg/dL). Review carbohydrate pattern and care plan.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM hba1c_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND hba1c_percent >= 8.0 ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: HbA1c log is 8.0% or higher. Review diabetes plan and nutrition targets with a licensed clinician.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'bp_systolic' AND value >= 140 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Blood pressure log is elevated (>=140 systolic). Review sodium target and monitoring plan with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM creatinine_egfr_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND egfr_ml_min < 60 AND ckd_stage IN ('Stage 3a' 'Stage 3b') ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Kidney function log matches CKD Stage 3 criteria. Review phosphorus targets with a licensed clinician.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM creatinine_egfr_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND egfr_ml_min < 30 AND ckd_stage = 'Stage 4' ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: eGFR log is below 30 with Stage 4 CKD label. Review protein and mineral targets with a nephrology clinician.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'hemoglobin' AND value < 11.0 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Hemoglobin log is below range (Hb <11 g/dL). Review iron status and diet plan with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'cholesterol_total' AND value >= 240 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Cholesterol log is above threshold (>=240 mg/dL). Review fat intake pattern with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'ldl' AND value >= 160 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: LDL log is above threshold (>=160 mg/dL). Review medication schedule and follow-up plan.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT user_id AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'taken' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adherence_rate FROM adherence_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND scheduled_at >= DATE('now' '-30 days') GROUP BY user_id) WHERE adherence_rate < 0.75
recommendation_text: Medication adherence is below 75% this month. Review barriers and schedule with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'weight' AND value <= (SELECT value * 0.95 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'weight' ORDER BY recorded_at ASC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Congratulations! You've lost 5% or more of your starting weight. Keep up the great work!

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM hba1c_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND hba1c_percent <= (SELECT hba1c_percent - 0.5 FROM hba1c_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Excellent! Your HbA1c dropped by 0.5% or more. Your efforts are paying off!

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS control_days FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'bp_systolic' AND value < 140 AND recorded_at >= DATE('now' '-30 days')) WHERE control_days >= 25
recommendation_text: Great job! Your blood pressure has been under control for 25+ days this month.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(meal_time)) AS logged_days FROM meals WHERE user_id = :user_id AND meal_time >= DATE('now' '-7 days')) WHERE logged_days >= 7
recommendation_text: You've logged meals for 7 days straight! Consistency is key to health improvement.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(meal_time)) AS logged_days FROM meals WHERE user_id = :user_id AND meal_time >= DATE('now' '-7 days')) WHERE logged_days < 3
recommendation_text: Meals were logged on fewer than 3 days this week. More context improves the nutrition summary.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM daily_nutrition_summary WHERE user_id = :user_id AND date >= DATE('now' '-7 days') GROUP BY user_id HAVING AVG(fiber_g) < 15
recommendation_text: Fiber intake log is low (avg <15g/day). Review fiber targets and food options with the care plan.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM hydration_log WHERE user_id = :user_id AND date = DATE('now') GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(amount_ml) < 1000
recommendation_text: Hydration log is below 1 liter today. Add context or review hydration target with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM daily_nutrition_summary WHERE user_id = :user_id AND date >= DATE('now' '-7 days') GROUP BY user_id HAVING AVG(sodium_mg) > 2300
recommendation_text: Average sodium intake log is above target (>2300mg/day). Review sodium sources and target range.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM daily_nutrition_summary WHERE user_id = :user_id AND date >= DATE('now' '-7 days') GROUP BY user_id HAVING AVG(sugar_g) > 50
recommendation_text: Average sugar intake log is above target (avg >50g/day). Review sugar sources and target range.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'vitamin_d' AND value < 20 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Vitamin D log is below range (<20 ng/mL). Review diet exposure and supplement plan with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'vitamin_b12' AND value < 200 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Vitamin B12 log is below range (<200 pg/mL). Review diet and supplement plan with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'ferritin' AND value < 30 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Iron stores log is below range (ferritin <30 ng/mL). Review iron plan and meal timing with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'calcium' AND value < 8.5 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Calcium log is below range (<8.5 mg/dL). Review calcium target and food options with the care team.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM hba1c_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND hba1c_percent >= 5.7 AND hba1c_percent < 6.5 ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: HbA1c log falls in the prediabetes range (5.7-6.4%). Review diet and activity plan with a licensed clinician.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM hba1c_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND hba1c_percent >= 6.5 ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_conditions WHERE user_id = :user_id AND condition = 'Diabetes')
recommendation_text: HbA1c log is at or above the diabetes threshold (>=6.5%). Arrange clinical evaluation with a licensed clinician.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM creatinine_egfr_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND egfr_ml_min < 60 ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_conditions WHERE user_id = :user_id AND condition = 'CKD')
recommendation_text: eGFR log is below 60. Arrange kidney function review with a licensed clinician.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT AVG(value) AS avg_bp FROM clinical_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND metric_type = 'bp_systolic' AND recorded_at >= DATE('now' '-30 days')) WHERE avg_bp >= 140
recommendation_text: Average systolic blood pressure log is >=140 over 30 days. Arrange clinical review.

condition_sql: SELECT 1 FROM potassium_logs WHERE user_id = :user_id AND potassium_value > 6.0 ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 1
recommendation_text: Safety notice: potassium log is above 6.0 mEq/L. Follow the local emergency care protocol.

recommendation_text: Safety notice: blood sugar log is below 70 mg/dL. Follow the clinician-provided hypoglycemia protocol.
